value.title: Denaro Falso
value.synopsis: Yuri is on a date, so when a job comes up Kei has to partner with Calico to intercept a counterfeiter.

value.title: Il grande cannone
value.synopsis: Chief Gooley inspects the 3WA Weapons Lab, but Marcus has taken over and executed everyone. Gooley is taken hostage and the city is held to ransom with Marcus's God Cannon.
